text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《真实简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《真實簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Remember, you can watch a video version of this podcast on our website,
zh: 记住，你可以在我们的网站上观看本播客的视频版本，
zh_hant: 記住，你可以在我們的網站上觀看本播客的影片版本，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
How are you today, Georgie?
I'm very well, thank you, today, Neil.
How are you?
I'm OK.
I've got one or two little worries .
Have you?
Well, that's interesting because we are talking about worries today
zh: 嗯，那很有趣，因为我们今天要谈论烦恼
zh_hant: 嗯，那很有趣，因為我們今天要談論煩惱

text: in this podcast.
are problems that make you feel upset or scared.
zh: 是让你感到难过或害怕的问题。
zh_hant: 是讓你感到難過或害怕的問題。

text: So shall we start the conversation?
Let's do it.
So, Neil, you said you've got a couple of little worries .
zh: 那么，尼尔，你说你有几个小烦恼。
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你說你有幾個小煩惱。

text: Do you want to share them?
Yeah.
I think, I think when you have kids,
zh: 我觉得，我觉得当你有孩子的时候，
zh_hant: 我覺得，我覺得當你有孩子的時候，

text: you're kind of slightly worried all the time.
And yesterday, my son got hurt playing cricket.
zh: 昨天，我儿子打板球时受伤了。
zh_hant: 昨天，我兒子打板球時受傷了。

text: And so this morning,
I just wanted to make sure he was feeling OK before he went to school.
zh: 我只是想确保他上学前感觉还好。
zh_hant: 我只是想確保他上學前感覺還好。

text: And how was he this morning?
He seemed OK.
Yeah, he seemed a bit bruised.
zh: 是的，他看起来有点淤青。
zh_hant: 是的，他看起來有點淤青。

text: Oh, no.
An injury to the knee or something?
Shoulder.
Ouch.
And arm.
Gosh.
Yeah.
And do you...
Are you someone that worries a lot?
zh: 你是一个容易担心的人吗？
zh_hant: 你是一個容易擔心的人嗎？

text: No, not really.
Sometimes, but I think
there's lots of stuff that you can worry about.
zh: 有很多事情可以让你担心。
zh_hant: 有很多事情可以讓你擔心。

text: And if you, if you worry
about all of it,
can really affect you badly.
So I try, I know it's difficult sometimes,
zh: 所以我尽量，我知道有时候很难，
zh_hant: 所以我儘量，我知道有時候很難，

text: not to worry too much about things that aren't so important.
zh: 不要太担心那些不那么重要的事情。
zh_hant: 不要太擔心那些不那麼重要的事情。

text: My thing is that worrying about a problem
zh: 我的观点是，担心一个问题
zh_hant: 我的觀點是，擔心一個問題

text: or a thing doesn't actually help.
zh: 或一件事情实际上没有帮助。
zh_hant: 或一件事情實際上沒有幫助。

text: So I'm in general,
I'm a person that doesn't worry too much.
zh: 我是一个不太担心的人。
zh_hant: 我是一個不太擔心的人。

text: I kind of just think whatever happens, happens.
zh: 我基本上觉得，该发生的总会发生。
zh_hant: 我基本上覺得，該發生的總會發生。

text: So I'm generally quite chilled and relaxed.
zh: 所以我通常很放松、很冷静。
zh_hant: 所以我通常很放鬆、很冷靜。

text: That's true.
That's a very healthy attitude probably.
zh: 那可能是一种非常健康的态度。
zh_hant: 那可能是一種非常健康的態度。

text: So I don't tend to worry a lot.
zh: 所以我倾向于不太担心。
zh_hant: 所以我傾向於不太擔心。

text: But you, you worry a little bit because you have kids.
zh: 但你会因为你有了孩子而有点担心。
zh_hant: 但你會因為你有了孩子而有點擔心。

text: What kinds of things do you do to make yourself feel more relaxed?
zh: 你通常会做些什么来让自己更放松？
zh_hant: 你通常會做些什麼來讓自己更放鬆？

text: Well, I think, like you said,
one useful thing to do could be to try
zh: 一件有用的事情可能是试着
zh_hant: 一件有用的事情可能是試著

text: to be rational.
So to think that what you're worried
zh: 也就是想，你担心的事情
zh_hant: 也就是想，你擔心的事情

text: about probably
isn't that important or, likely
zh: 没那么重要，或者不太可能
zh_hant: 沒那麼重要，或者不太可能

text: to happen.
But, yeah.
So you're quite chilled , as you said.
zh: 所以你很放松，就像你说的。
zh_hant: 所以你很放鬆，就像你說的。

text: That must be nice for your friends.
zh: 那对你的朋友来说一定很好。
zh_hant: 那對你的朋友來說一定很好。

text: Yes.
And if you have, like you said, a friend who's, who worries about everything,
zh: 如果你有一个，就像你说的，什么事都担心的朋友，
zh_hant: 如果你有一個，就像你說的，什麼事都擔心的朋友，

text: how do you help them?
Finding maybe a distraction.
zh: 找到某种分散注意力的方法。
zh_hant: 找到某種分散注意力的方法。

text: Like something that makes you feel good.
zh: 比如能让你感觉好的事情。
zh_hant: 比如能讓你感覺好的事情。

text: Like a TV programme that you love.
zh: 比如你喜欢的电视节目。
zh_hant: 比如你喜歡的電視節目。

text: Or seeing friends,
that love you, that can make you feel more relaxed.
zh: 那些爱你的朋友，能让你更放松。
zh_hant: 那些愛你的朋友，能讓你更放鬆。

text: Mindfulness techniques as well.
Maybe jigsaws.
I've talked about puzzles in the past.
Do you have any other tips?
No.
These are all very good ideas.
zh: 这些都是非常好的主意。
zh_hant: 這些都是非常好的主意。

text: Thank you.
Yeah.
I think it can be useful to have something that distracts you.
zh: 我觉得有东西分散注意力可能很有用。
zh_hant: 我覺得有東西分散注意力可能很有用。

text: Like maybe drawing, listening to music,
playing an instrument can help.
Something that just kind of takes that time away.
zh: 就是那种能消磨时间的事情。
zh_hant: 就是那種能消磨時間的事情。

text: It takes your mind off the the stress.
Yeah.
OK.
Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation,
zh: 让我们回顾一下对话中听到的词汇，
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下對話中聽到的詞彙，

text: starting with worry .
A worry is a problem that makes you feel upset or scared,
zh: Worry是让你感到难过或害怕的问题，
zh_hant: Worry是讓你感到難過或害怕的問題，

text: and worry is also a verb.
So for example, I worry about my kids.
Yes, and we also use the adjective worried
zh: 是的，我们还用了形容词worried
zh_hant: 是的，我們還用了形容詞worried

text: to describe that feeling of being scared or upset about something.
zh: 来描述对某事感到害怕或难过的感觉。
zh_hant: 來描述對某事感到害怕或難過的感覺。

text: For example, I'm worried about climate change.
And we heard the expression take your mind off something,
zh: 我们还听到了短语take your mind off something，
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了短語take your mind off something，

text: which means to do something to stop you worrying .
zh: 意思是做某事来停止担心。
zh_hant: 意思是做某事來停止擔心。

text: For example, I play my guitar to take my mind off
my worries .
We also heard chilled , which is another word
zh: 我们还听到了chilled，这是另一个词，
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了chilled，這是另一個詞，

text: for relaxed or calm.
And it's quite an informal word.
zh: 这是一个比较非正式的词。
zh_hant: 這是一個比較非正式的詞。

text: Next time we'll be talking
about our brains.
See you then.
Goodbye.
